descriptive_result: The replicated secondary-history comparator is not uniquely isolated in the current four-variable environmental-position space. The largest dominant-radiation leave-one-out displacement and largest within-dominant pairwise distance exceed the corresponding secondary-history distances.
claim_boundary: Species medians from the Azami public-image occurrence context are not complete niche distributions. C. lineare has only three balanced observations. This result does not estimate niche evolutionary rate, ecological opportunity, selection or adaptation.
